description: One entry per asset (Bitcoin, ETH, SOL, USDC, USDT and every other tracked stablecoin, tokenized Treasury and L1) with its best current yield across DeFi and CeFi under BitcoinYield's risk-weighted ranking, its A-D risk grade, and a link to the full comparison. best_apy is the reported rate in percent and rate_basis says whether the source quotes it as an APY or an APR. Set max_risk to limit the pick to offers graded at or below that letter (A = lower risk, B = moderate). Rates are variable and not advice. No key required.

asset.description: Filter to one asset by its symbol, e.g. BTC, USDC or USDE.

max_risk.description: Only consider offers graded at or below this letter: A (lower risk), B (moderate), C (elevated), D (higher).

stablecoin.description: Set to "true" to return only stablecoin assets.

name: list_yields

degraded_sources.description: The sources missing from this snapshot, if any.

partial.description: True when a data source was missing from this snapshot.

stale.description: True when part of this snapshot is over 6 hours old (a scheduled refresh was missed).

updated_at.description: When the feed was last refreshed (ISO 8601). It refreshes every 3 hours.

best_apy.description: The best current rate in percent (5.2 means 5.2%). An APR when rate_basis says so; the name is kept for compatibility.

peg_price.description: For a stablecoin: the live price of the dollar the best yield is paid in (1 = on its $1 peg). Null when unpriced or not a stablecoin.

rate_basis.description: Whether the source reports best_apy as an APY (compounded) or an APR; unknown when it does not say.

url.description: The full comparison for this asset on BitcoinYield.

title: List the best yield per asset
